name: compare_options
retrieval: same snapshot keyword evidence for both options; include approved project files
citation: Exact supporting quotations retain source ID/version/hash/time or original file lines. Model synthesis is separately labelled inference with IDs of validated quotations; structural validation is not semantic proof.
abstention: If one option lacks evidence, label that comparison incomplete
task_steps: Describe each named option separately, including any missing evidence for an option.
Compare tradeoffs on dimensions actually mentioned: deployment, complexity, latency, capacity or constraints.
Explain how current project code supports or limits each option. Do not invent benchmark numbers or a winner.
